description: This file defines the final class 'ExtensionSet' within the Twig namespace, managing Twig extensions, including registration, initialization, and retrieval of filters, functions, tests, node visitors, token parsers, and operators. It contains core logic for maintaining and interacting with a set of Twig extensions in a PHP project.

classes.name: ExtensionSet
classes.description: Manages a collection of Twig extensions, enabling their registration, initialization, and access to their features such as filters, functions, tests, node visitors, token parsers, and operators.

methods.name: initRuntime
methods.description: Initializes the runtime environment for Twig extensions.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension class is registered.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension instance by class name.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representing the extension classes registered.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if extensions have been fully initialized.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns the latest modification timestamp among registered extensions.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific function by name.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFunctionCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined functions.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a specific filter by name.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFilterCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined filters.

methods.name: getTokenParser
methods.description: Retrieves a token parser by name.

methods.name: registerUndefinedTokenParserCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined token parsers.

methods.name: getGlobals
methods.description: Returns global variables provided by extensions.

methods.name: getTest
methods.description: Retrieves a specific test by name.
